question: We are a conservation charity working in Breckland. How much carbon is held in the hedgerow and field trees outside the forest, what would ash dieback do to it and how much would replanting recover? How has the biomass of Thetford Forest changed since 2015, and how much grassland and grazing livestock is there in the same area for heathland and grassland restoration?

assumptions.assumption: The DT6 'breckland' 5 km pilot tile stands in for Breckland's trees outside woodland; results are for that tile only, at the latest lidar date.
assumptions.rationale: DT6 covers only ten 5 km pilot tiles; Breckland is one.

assumptions.assumption: DT6 defaults: ash 15% of broadleaved TOW trees, final mortality 80%, tau 10 years, 70% of dead trees to firewood, 30 years from 2025. Replanting compared at 0% (no replanting) and 100% of dead ash replaced by young trees (upper bound), plus 50% as a central case.
assumptions.rationale: No open map gives the local ash share; default values are the agent's; replant shares bracket the recovery.

assumptions.assumption: Whole DT4 'thetford' landscape, CCI v7 AGB change 2015 to 2024 plus the annual series.
assumptions.rationale: User asks 'since 2015'; 2024 is the latest CCI map.

assumptions.assumption: A 15 km radius around 52.45 N, 0.70 E (Thetford Forest / central Breckland) for DT2 grassland and livestock; AR5 GWP100 for CO2e as the inventory uses.
assumptions.rationale: Approximates 'the same area' as Thetford Forest and the Brecks heaths; DT2 needs a point and radius.

assumptions: Inventory: National Trees Outside Woodland map V1 (lone trees, groups of trees, small woodlands; canopy > 3 m outside NFI woodland). NFI overhanging canopy is left to DT4, hedges below 3 m to DT5.
Calibrated on Environment Agency lidar canopy heights only: first and last return of the National LIDAR Programme and last-return LIDAR Tiles DSMs back to 1998, all above the NLP terrain model.
Biomass from crown size and height with Jucker et al. (2017); trees in groups share the object's crown area equally; leaf type is a pilot prior (no open leaf-type map for TOW).
Crown light-use model climate: HadUK-Grid 1991-2020 monthly averages; radiation from Hargreaves-Samani.
Trees removed before the TOW map was made (2016-2023 lidar) are not in the inventory, so their loss is not seen.

provenance.licence: ESA CCI Biomass terms and conditions v2: free and open, citation required
provenance.inventory: National Forest Inventory Woodland GB 2024 and Forestry England Subcompartments, Forestry Commission open data. Contains, or is based on, information supplied by the Forestry Commission; Open Government Licence v3.0.
assumptions: Calibrated on ESA Biomass CCI v7 only (no GEDI, ICESat-2, lidar or other satellite data).

Woodland mask from the NFI woodland map GB 2024; species groups, planting years (stand ages) and Forestry England yield classes from the FE sub-compartment database. FE yield class is only an independent check, never used in calibration.
Pixels outside the FE estate take a species group from the NFI forest type (conifer, felled and young types: the landscape's dominant conifer; broadleaved types: mixed broadleaves).
3-PG climate: HadUK-Grid 1991-2020 monthly averages (Met Office portal, ~2 km and 12 km grids); radiation estimated from the diurnal temperature range (Hargreaves-Samani).
CCI v7 saturates at about 150 Mg/ha in these forests; calibration compares CCI with min(model AGB, 150). Each pixel is treated as an unthinned even-aged stand.

result.sensor_epoch_note: 2005-2012 maps use ALOS PALSAR/Envisat, 2015-2024 ALOS-2/Sentinel-1; compare levels across the gap with care.

1.caption: Ensemble mean living biomass carbon (t C) of the 3,727 trees outside woodland in the 25 km² Breckland tile, size-age growth model, 2025-2055. Dieback: 15% ash, 80% final mortality, tau 10 yr; replanting 50% or 100% of dead ash [R3][R4][R5]. Model responses, not observations.

2.caption: Mean AGB (Mg/ha) of the 13,670 ha of woodland in the Thetford landscape with 90% range of the area mean, 2015-2024 [R7]. The 2015-2024 change of -6.0 Mg/ha is not significant at 90% [R6].
